messages.text: When did Cedar actually ship, and was it late against the revised plan? Request evidence if missing. You may propose learning separately.

result.answer: The revised plan calls for shipment on 17 June 2026, but the supplied evidence does not establish actual shipment: the revised source says it is unconfirmed. I cannot determine an actual date or lateness from these records. Please obtain an authorized dispatch record identifying Cedar and its actual shipment date; I have not initiated collection.
